issues.where: Section 2(c) prompt and exemplar (clinical thermometer suitability)
issues.problem: The exemplar says the clinical thermometer's scale 'does not go below about 35 °C (Lesson 2)'. Lesson 2 never taught or gave this scale range. It only had learners identify the constriction at Station B. The prompt therefore asks learners to decide using a fact the lessons did not supply, and the exemplar wrongly attributes it to Lesson 2. The decision should rest on what was taught (the constriction stops the column falling, so it is designed to hold a reading and is unsuitable for tracking a freezer). Alternatively the scale range should be added to the lesson first.
